messages:
Mira: Quick sync — I pushed a new content pass for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing trio in Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Goal: single narrative that routes users into 3 conversion lanes (self-serve hosted sign-up, reserved commit demo, private deployment contact) + a webinar CTA. Please skim and flag anything that blocks copy handoff by EOD.
Sam: Looking now. One quick thought — the top-line headline feels generic. What if we try: 'Serve LLMs at production scale — predictably, affordably, everywhere.' Short, matches tri-mode. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 
Olivia: I like Sam's direction. Suggest subhead callout for economics: 'Control latency and cost with smart routing, autoscaling, and caching.' Keep Hosted hero CTA as 'Start free' and Dedicated as 'Request reserved capacity demo'. Private should be 'Talk to sales'.
Mira: Agree on CTAs. Can we make the Webinar CTA more specific (not just 'Join webinar') — something like 'Live playbook: cut inference cost 2x without model changes'. That gives a benchmark hook.
Devon: For inbound, we need a form field to capture "deployment_intent" and "expected_qps". Routing rules I'll implement in the lead flow. Draft routing snippet:
```
if deployment_intent == 'private': route -> AE_Private_queue
elif deployment_intent == 'dedicated': route -> AE_Dedicated_queue
else: route -> Marketing_SelfServe_queue
```
Also add hidden utm param mapping for benchmarks source (e.g., /benchmarks?src=post).
Priya: Webinar logistics: we can schedule the webinar the week after launch to capture signups from the hero. Proposed title: 'Serving LLMs in Production: latency, cost, and rollouts' — 45 min + 15 min Q&A. Speakers: Devon (runtime), Mira (product), and a customer brief (TBD). I'll draft registration copy and slide deck outline.
Sam: A/B test idea — change hosted hero to highlight 'instant API' vs 'predictable economics' for two cohorts and measure signups + watch webinar CTR. Keep the benchmark claim as a social proof blurb under hero: 'Observed: 2x cost reduction on conversational workloads — Redwood customers'.
Olivia: For Private page copy: emphasize compliance + network controls before any cost language. Many security teams hunt for that first. Example line: 'Deploy behind your VPC — full audit logs and KMS/HSM integrations.'
Mira: Nice. We'll need separate meta descriptions for SEO. I'll add: Hosted: 'Developer API for fast LLM inference'; Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput'; Private: 'On-prem and VPC deployments for regulated workloads'.
Devon: Ops note — make sure the demo request form triggers the Dedicated SLA auto-email template (dedicated_sla_v1). Otherwise buyers wait too long.
Priya: I'll create the webinar landing page draft and wire up registration -> Salesforce campaign: 'Webinar_Serving_Playbook_Mar'. Also set campaign source mapping so we can trace signups back to hero vs benchmarks page.
ops-bot: reminder: marketing A/B test 'hosted_hero_variant' scheduled for 2134570000 UTC.
Mira: Thanks everyone — action items: Olivia update Private copy and compliance lines; Sam set A/B test variants; Devon wire routing + demo email; Priya build webinar page + campaign; I'll QA copy + meta descriptions and sync with dev for rollout. Ping me if anything slips. :rocket:
